decisions.reason: Although this desk lamp is less central than the firm's intelligent building systems, the dedicated launch, accumulated development effort and ease of attributing any weak uptake to temporary office-project timing make management inclined to continue with it.

As a general interior luminaire close to the firm's core building-lighting business, this product benefits from strong strategic fit, visible prior commitment and the usual tendency to persist after a recent launch.
Because management presented this pendant luminaire as a flagship for the firm's direction, the high public commitment and strategic centrality make withdrawal very unlikely.

Even after trimming other marine lines, management is likely to retain this marine searchlight as the remaining specialist offer, justifying continued support by the sunk engineering effort and long, uneven marine purchasing cycles.
